what: No bin over crates.io libc 0.2.191 links on this Mac (macOS 27 SDK): blaze-link native.rs:1898 "MacOSX27.0.sdk/usr/lib/libiconv.tbd names /usr/lib/libcharset.1.dylib, which the link line does not have". libc #[link(name = "iconv")]s on Apple targets; libiconv.tbd re-exports libcharset by install name, which the linker finds in the SDK (or takes from the tbd re-export list), not from the link line: the shared.inputs check fits ELF DT_NEEDED but not a Mach-O re-export.
